cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a hub runs an incubation or acceleration programme with a cohort of startups: the Digital Malawi Project's 10 tech hubs are reported for digital-skills training and seed funding to some beneficiaries, not for a startup cohort.
cells.note: Ten government tech hubs are open, but the programme on record is skills training and seed grants, not incubation of a startup cohort, so stage 2. Not stage 3 until a hub's incubation or acceleration cohort is held.
